**Article Details for PMID: 42423636**

**Title:** Beyond Amplification: Precision Approaches to Targeting HER2.

**Authors:** Maxwell R Lloyd, Mark D Pegram, Seth A Wander

**Journal:** Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
**Publication Date:** 2026-09-01
**DOI:** 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-26-1340

**Abstract:**
HER2-directed tyrosine kinase inhibitor combinations with trastuzumab represent an emerging strategy for hormone receptor-negative or -positive metastatic breast cancer with activating HER2 mutations. Correlative genomics reveal on-target and downstream molecular evolution during treatment, identifying response patterns and potential acquired resistance mechanisms. Refining precision therapies for HER2-mutant breast cancer remains a priority. See related article by Jhaveri et al., p. 3735.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
